--- >Every part of the city has its own little details and unique characteristics; even within the city itself, there are areas, neighbourhoods, beaches and parks that seem to belong to a different city altogether. --- ![Image_1776727595637.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wqq2XR1cvku8NVyCs8xoHSekN9xvvUmWvkaRPUe1fB55spR6EkVJM3E6SseUW6YvYqG.jpg) --- So far, I’ve visited several beaches; in some cases, I’ve gone specifically to one of them, and in others, I’ve taken a long walk along several, when they aren’t too long. But in this case, I’m bringing you one of the most popular beaches; in fact, I believe, in my opinion and based on my visits, that it’s the second most popular in Málaga. The first is La Malagueta. I usually prefer quieter beaches for relaxing and enjoying the sea, and although at first, when I arrived in Málaga, I used to go to the most famous and touristy one, it was always very crowded, so for quite some time I chose to walk a bit further and head to La Caleta. --- ![20250912_172224.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vYdMTrVQzkGhYKZCu2mBpVcFVG9nxDzFvLBPu4jFggYFYn2piV1KLVgk8bFQxyP38ro.jpg) ![20250912_172227.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243Lxi8U36t9Q9iF2FW2XEDevgHUvikxKaNWDtUCxUgvTdc9nj3Cdd3gdzRQn9h77D4pb.jpg) ![20250912_172234.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23y8oasjGsKp84tNxTtBiuinHf7aqLXgebwTnbH45555Mo9GUqsAwUzszeUZi6qUwG4td.jpg) ![20250922_164416.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xKrQJ4orJDiTUM9wcK4Hyrb5TtiV9sBGXUeR6y6RtWjohZtTtrJcfrVA82zjiw5zwo5.jpg) ![20250922_174524.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23v4c45gc7kLUjxZ8NjPXRpuSJFkRzPj1cseqmtoDBsiugTT9uQS85mL4baV9fcwHZXS1.jpg) ![20250922_174507.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241QTNFMsQyu2orvAL6gxdWxoLUnkueopt151XWu3SLseWhhkn2R6jzKhHEJxtVWXVGrY.jpg) ![20250922_174627.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vYjfrkbne36RDUh9B8tQRujEnDL23dVgY4TswXioZWtTC5Qe935qGQUmP7i3P2a5JhY.jpg) ![20250922_174631.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zGa9KSPMgvH9b7SdGJxMvm7MbHdjuBZwbtvoTiSMYy3i5xodmtWJmubGXp1zMKgk4kc.jpg) --- Walking along its promenade offers the chance to look out over the Mediterranean Sea on one side and the various buildings on the other, many of them hotels or places exclusively for tourists, although there are people who have flats overlooking the sea. That’s the best bit of all. The sea is always my favourite thing to see on my walk, but this beach is full of beach bars with excellent restaurants and plenty of space, where you can choose to eat inside or on the terraces with an incredible view of the water and the horizon. --- ![20250922_174734.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23r1nzhcKnUkbLqbGRpbMzyqRcu3wNqxiYnCAzCv9kPoeRXoKEX5xSVb9hRAdWbxJxRHj.jpg) ![20250922_174642.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sdfpngHUaa9Rbt6BjVeiXy2GzVtiuiR4fSdJU4PYcAc99wNFEq47yVmY88XWfGdNUsj.jpg) ![20250922_174655.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23xVEhKKc9sPLLUiXBnYKJA4djL1TaaBLdnEvR4wD1K2Qtdh5MiUs1w6epqW5NDfWRMSR.jpg) ![20250922_174736.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yd5nTzXoxFNLdJmmFX2KimP27GRhgAYvSTUodbk32rq6ZTboz6fzHzfkrEJsLQcNXes.jpg) ![20250922_175047.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245ca8mn4bpcpo4SjELecKLzXSM497WvrL6jCfY32ePqBxtwuhTDPCt5doHRSSu5JvMgu.jpg) ![20250922_175332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245TEGnq3Wd3JuEpV6eUPVXcRjC8xekMuiGGyAjiWXGthgEbnJNyDdjfEvKEdNYAaA2Wi.jpg) ![20250922_175400.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244odaCjverZJV8gwekhv6YR5AqKqcE86fEhHs5gM12ocnHdUMLE3xv4LLgMcQXp88ZzM.jpg) --- It’s a beach full of green spaces near the promenade, with plenty of palm trees, so you can enjoy the shade in the height of summer, have a picnic, or make the most of the sunny spots. To be honest, I prefer the sunny spots; I love sunbathing whenever I can. According to the information signs that appear every now and then on the beach, it stretches for 1,000 metres, although it seems much longer. I usually walk from west to east, but on this occasion I started the other way round. --- ![20250922_174830.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23vPLieHRRSp3jQuMdH5AXc7GSHgdUzkpLXVtM1HkjJLzBXJ4ZeGMvwuoDJ7dxde8fKNU.jpg) ![20250922_174824.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243zff9iHrnd5nbNJWP6ZjJWH2qCmnqsfA6GWgnaHvCEsA6FsZY4QyUbWwPg2QjktwwKw.jpg) ![20250922_175315.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244A2UA8x7q2yJYKwpPUCHLMAHLrzX2MSRHB2SZEhVUkFAmQKhGTAKxTiFzhAporevfX7.jpg) ![20250922_175423.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2432BAUfB459GtVKPtx5uMEpjtiqMEJNHkL3vU43ugkCt1tX54WWSiU8FkwroZNE6vvtx.jpg) ![20250922_175749.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243zZRmLTELLXGgdGqwv9Z3ze7CPZ3inbAs93WZxzmd3L3imdbCsWDNymiMArAnGM3rxf.jpg) ![20250922_175427.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23z7Bd7GXnaK4RSM8Wtkh1WbrP93DiyJwtrgWm7fPSjMfsXPJmQcXKunS72BprdpSy3ub.jpg) ![20250922_175508.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/2432FMRvVm3MLrD7biPLFx3pnaNbo1qQ8RMAZmkh3st5bQ2HT2xmY8qdktoHRs2TxT2A4.jpg) ![20250922_175606.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244odaD6XoUAXJKyHb462QeD44ExA6XXmDJZuXNEsBHAUZX6NE4MxqGH8EZa71YPyth3d.jpg) --- La Caleta beach is situated between Baños del Carmen beach, or rather, from a stretch of beach just beyond the latter, which forms part of Pedregalejo beach, and extends all the way to La Malagueta beach. It’s in the eastern part of the city, which I think is why it’s one of the most popular with tourists. The beaches in the western part are more family-oriented. The promenade that runs alongside it is the Pablo Ruiz Picasso Promenade. It’s a beach where, although there are plenty of tourists, it’s better maintained than La Malagueta, and over the years I’ve seen various improvements, such as pedestrian walkways and cycle paths, improvements that keep it in good condition and make it appealing to visitors. It is one of the beaches closest to the city centre, which I think is why it is the second most popular choice. --- ![20250922_180016.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sUGWny88uFHNdNmWMS6nB1sbKGuRwe4Qr3ydumv83BSHJrnX473EfkKsZzZcJ2cSq5P.jpg) ![20250922_180021.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241tWyhRV5zsHzBEra6P8BnrcMaePG11Bp1TpNXn13UGXBjrPnE4kxzmLayMefYcCWMtp.jpg) ![20250922_175555.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wMWDtMTsfswoi64BEVaYMYbzWEKa6oHxMZ2PiwUeWQy6kRho4CXqYLrzgKKgTeBFxaB.jpg) ![20250922_180149.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243fp1KW4S2KDpCCRgij5Z8bJshbvgFqDvTT9sDLSAQYwhPXqWtxvHVEqRNYNhGPHtG4d.jpg) ![20250922_180248.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244A4viRH6V6x9nXFCAJbXK1ur2QfzkfczEDDotV3QYRwTxq65zkTQyBHZpcaobNnrqsz.jpg) ![20250922_180143.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sJrT1w2RL4atARwnQfmrdsGN99g7SmK49fwMuj14iB46ENJ1gavm5JEDwyk781egp7M.jpg) ![20250922_180332.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/241Zt6hpZRRPj2PuCw2tnx5vNm5VCuicGEAug7nMhQZi1STsu8oT4UZDKXx6qLTi9Fo7M.jpg) --- In the past, it was also a quiet beach used for fishing, like so many others in the eastern part of the city, but there have been so many improvements that the difference from the others is now very noticeable, particularly in the buildings, structures and even the sand. As I mentioned, every so often along the stretch there is a beach bar with very modern restaurants, each with its own style, and I think this is one of the things that sets it apart the most. --- ![20250922_180432.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23ujmxJM9HUgfQDW7YA8r86WHFCTCBWkjMhK1vgwuWxkHQoEoPHPn3sd9DVNFEhrxu4YG.jpg) ![20250922_180255.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/243fpTSMdc1gY4VGGzzKWRgQnQ16bR67M2nbBHep1QtSyKLmBW6UYk1jS5BQ27fh68fhP.jpg) ![20250922_180726.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245myNMWC8UehzYV5M9KaEvEd2SNpifgMemRg18xcrXHu8FSySL6aB9ea6DKCYu6o6YWq.jpg) ![20250922_180530.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244eGkUdcfQvXyuo4QnK7AA7cXsiao62tfZ2d1eZg8kiAY4wHmcWSije79Lrf3VBdZ14x.jpg) ![20250922_180526.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/244y1hGVZtHggo5cGgcSmhsubDQzyBY7eTxE1fE1nFgKPsNk129ZNGztUwk9e8iwetyMt.jpg)
![20250922_180604.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wqs27pQv4Hjw2hXxh1V3NKp59rtETXJMm8cymURwuXFKidVaHS9QoKrkpScjZyuqY5t.jpg)
![20250922_180608.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242Y9vRfhuACFGkWJ2u6rim5RtVKxe5sDkNKH3L4bAzG1wk7tGkrHUrw63W76KyeGQbtu.jpg) --- It shares its name with, or derives its name from, the neighbourhood nearby, which was once a very affluent area, home to the bourgeoisie, particularly in the late 19th century. The beach is part of a luxury residential area; indeed, one of the finest hotels, the five-star Hotel Miramar, is situated very close by, overlooking the sea. It is the most luxurious hotel I have ever seen. --- ![20250922_181301.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23yJJkd1qUKYAVX85L6UoLWyuhvj6kCbUNqNgBNDoxyd4bRevqsDkmyzXtB3qRqCJdMuC.jpg) ![20250922_181322.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sUMBJeiYSr4L38mXtvipDqFgG4gyxhUKXbKRT52danejpz4mg9FpW48qEyeeuNkEFmS.jpg) ![20250922_181331.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242ryBXpCCpZJQWcaQiFTSErARFbaXBwNPjjx9axomrsUaeWy71T3cCPDLEHSqd5gMEwH.jpg) ![20250922_181435.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242NjC3MAVzZYKmbkGhwYWp7HUtSxwsJmntQWMYvG35ncFSzjENvTap8UfGET8zRQ2MzZ.jpg) ![20250922_181334.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23wgMmUxtGVVHBabne4TKuaUfFnKK7xiSna6a7B1C5Uoq5RsR1o1v9A8surNrW3L9Gpze.jpg) --- Furthermore, as you’ll see in the photos, there are several public toilets along the route, and you can also use the toilets at the beach bars, even if you haven’t bought anything. But the toilets on the beach always feature murals in incredible colours. Art is everywhere I look, and that’s one of the things I enjoy most. --- ![20250922_181713.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zRwAAzvKydJNGgqCwBVFp1WVVdcboiZEBmdV1hJ92KJn4AK7XBP5Akno2EohhrHWRtb.jpg) ![20250922_181528.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23v4dcnEvB42GkqGMKDesdGzz5JbEhpYGqSHAbYGZnB2ZCn1GWRigqnL8jmuSEZ6ukv6A.jpg) ![20250922_181835.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242Nd7a6LnZfuZnmeci87B6xhmBnQW19wu8mKz7RRQELD4Z2yU7AEZQhYDxjsNuRdP7ZS.jpg) ![20250922_181803.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23zkprkMBXMmt2PBX7pXWB1VhNC6VA921CJ2HwDwkBz19DVdLEjDMhyHWk6BrojNyEjve.jpg) ![20250922_181911.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/245TBTyKtmwczZV3hKihGwpjNTzJRxRFcCqWG7C4QEEhbTL8aDAr5UarHPh9G3SSqQRs8.jpg) --- This beach has a distinctive, glamorous style, with modern-style buildings and structures; as you cross the avenue, you come across those beach bars that stand out so much on the beach and can be seen from afar, offering incredible sea views as you stroll along the promenade, which you can explore either on foot or by bike. In fact, many of the bike tours always pass through this spot. --- ![20250922_182005.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242NjBxF7fDGod5sxegriZq2GGNSJrQGGwpWe1CLfnHXubuBD842VvLSBFEpvovfvRu97.jpg) ![20250922_182011.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/242hURijTEW9kssZJhEkDrfJ3k9W8Sjd5MDeksgW3GFLQXCY6RHgTWWhjYWqJ93neFmNf.jpg) ![20250922_181921.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23r1kvGCKVEtUUjt5vdX4Edr14Qea4xnQ49zqrr9ZuFirmjKdJgp7gv7ce4QWosXK6TaV.jpg) ![20250922_182027.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/avdesing/23sUEwCnaG4Kpppwv85NKhpnYzSYH13Nwf8nWis4LnHfg9RWTChr5XLDH4zjExKsfm6Xs.jpg) --- If we add to all that the islands with their palm trees and a festive, cheerful atmosphere all the time, plus the warm sea wáter, ideal for enjoying yourself, it makes La Caleta beach one of the most visited and also one of the most sophisticated, so to speak. That’s why I said that each one has something special that sets it apart and makes it different from the others. I still have several left to explore, especially in the west, with more walks by the sea. Thank you very much for joining me today; I send you my warmest regards. See you soon. Amonet. --- ---

![1.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/23yJVVVGES7odUPH4dNBS41Zh9g6rwt8Fqa6guHGE7zpQEzCDtWvMPe5JnkJJAQEecYuS.png) ![gabriela travels divider gaming.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/Eo8L1q1q6J3nWWpu8NRh7jbJkzcHsrSTzBzVoM4DUXdS2497yfcDaSySrzHN2sFApL2.png) A few weeks ago I made [this post](https://peakd.com/hive-140217/@gabrielatravels/life-is-strange-reunion-a-game-series-that-marked-my-childhood-review-28) where I shared a personal review on my experience after playing **Life is Strange: Reunion**, which I've been waiting to be released since day 0 when it was first announced. This was mainly because I am a big fan when it comes to playing the Life is Strange series of games since I did it in some important moments of my life, but also because, ever since I started a [YouTube Gaming Channel](https://www.youtube.com/@doilupi), I never stopped thinking about how would it be to actually post only freshly released games. Along with turning the passion into a more expensive one, as it costs a little fortune to pre-order games in the 21st century, I am also not sure if it would actually be worth the financial efforts, since many bigger gaming channels get to play games way before they are released to the rest of the people. Hence why, those who are interested in some games have already watched gameplays way before you end up posting them on your own channel. Anyway, last night I started posting the gameplay videos from **Life is Strange: Reunion** on my YouTube Channel, and I thought I could also get back on making this kind of content on here too. Obviously, I am planning to keep these posts just once per week, as I don't want to be considered spam, although I post daily on my YT channel. But here we go with the first episode, as promised. https://youtu.be/tK49rsYk9J0?si=LIZZIlBdH7QwiZwM Why is this first video so important, you might wonder? Because it shows glimpses from all the other LIS games to make a little background of what **LIS: Reunion** is about for those who haven't played the previous games recently or at all. So, even if you are new in this game, you will understand the main parts of the story by simply watching the video from above, but I'd still recommend to play all the other games first so you make your own opinion on the overall story and don't judge the game's decisions based on just 10 minutes of intro which basically compress dozens of hours of gameplay from the first games. Oh, and let's not forget, my intro video might be different from yours. Or from anyone else who played this game. Because right after you get to meet Chloe and Max, you will need to make choices regarding Max's relationships with the other main characters of the game. Personally, I tried to be realistic and keep things simple yet interesting, but there can be a whole drama if you want! Anyway, I'll let you figure out what I'm talking about by checking the video out. 😁 - YouTube Channel: [Doi Lupi](https://www.youtube.com/@doilupi) - Life is Strange: Reunion Playlist: [click here](https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLkvfHkWRLyE1mf7wdxd2HoP2KmLVNjqRM&si=RdADNvIGJcnyaij9) ![gabriela travels divider gaming.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/gabrielatravels/Eo8L1q1q6J3nWWpu8NRh7jbJkzcHsrSTzBzVoM4DUXdS2497yfcDaSySrzHN2sFApL2.png)
**Gabriela Travels** is a Curator for [Worldmappin](https://peakd.com/c/hive-163772) and [Hive Gaming](https://peakd.com/c/hive-140217/created) communities, but also the FOUNDER of "[Festival Mania](https://peakd.com/c/hive-151446/created)" who started this community from the passion of attending various festivals and with the purpose of encouraging more people to explore festivals all around the world and share their experiences. At the same time, **Gabriela** is an independent Graphic Design Freelancer since 2019 completing over 600+ orders in this time and collaborating with various businesses and people from all over the globe. Additionally, **Gabriela** has her own corner on the internet since 2017 where she writes various articles for her blog, the most popular being the travel ones (350+ articles written on this field), but also approaching other topics as well, like game and book reviews, lets plays, movie and series reviews, photography posts, cooking recipes and more, boosting the total number of articles written to 850+ blog posts. **Gabriela** is also a gamer since she was 11 years old and gaming remains one of her biggest passions along with traveling, owning a YouTube channel for each of the two.

也许是年龄增长的缘故吧，每次回老家都特别珍惜回家的机会。

上次回老家，是去年7月份的时候，带着两个小家伙回老家待了阵子，一晃，这又快一年了。

总是说时间过的真快，时间真的是过的比想象中的还要快，尤其是每每想起来往事的时候。

院子里的那片空地里，已经长满了大葱、香菜、菠菜、草莓、韭菜等。

香菜因为很久没人摘，长的已有一尺多高，顶部也开了花。

至于菠菜，更是长到一米多高。。。这么高的菠菜，估计很多小伙伴们都没见过吧？囧

You know when people tell you that things happen for a reason, or to tell you something, like to slow down or to rest or whatever? 

Bollocks. 

There’s a particular kind of frustration that comes with finally feeling as though your body is returning to you, only for something else to go wrong at exactly the wrong moment, and I'm *not happy Jan* - to quote a 2000's Yellow Pages television ad that only Australians will recognise.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2akt3P8ltLM 

After months and months of hip pain, I had only just begun to feel that quiet sense of freedom again. My hips were good - god knows that's been a fkn journey - and I had started to think about the ocean again, about surfing, about that feeling of being out there in the water where everything seems to settle into place. I could *surf* again. Not as good as I used to, but *still*.

And then I came off my bike. You know, my lovely new e-bike Sandy that was giving me this sense of freedom and movement I was missing? 

It wasn’t anything dramatic either. I had just taken off, but my front wheel was sitting over a tree root, and I sort of tipped sideways. I even had a baguette in the back, which snapped clean in half, and at the time I remember thinking that was the worst of it. I picked myself up, told Jamie I was fine, and we cycled home.


![1506.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/243Lxz3pYdBuQCva654RNYqj3JyDHQXdL3MteuBe71FPWfyg2VfdWw3duf8APBWKN1tBd.jpg)


It turns out it wasn’t.

By the time I got home my arm had started to swell, and the pain set in properly. It’s one of those injuries that doesn’t fully announce itself straight away, but makes its presence very clear soon after, despite ice and comfrey cream and rest. A week later, thinking I’d recovered enough, I went out for a surf, only to find myself in so much pain that I had to paddle back in using one arm like a decripit Bethany Hamilton, my elbow swelling up all over again as if to say *you fuckwit, you knew it was too early to get back in the water*.

I’ve had it checked, and nothing is broken, which is something at least. Just a fair bit of soft tissue damage, which sounds minor until you try to use your arm for just about anything - and it's my right arm as well.

I'd also stupidly done a week of extreme knitting, two words the doctor said he'd never heard together in the same sentence. Turns out if you knit too much you get knitter's elbow. Du'oh.

It feels incredibly frustrating. There’s something about coming out of one period of pain, just beginning to trust your body again, only to be pulled up short by something else, that feels harder than if it had all just happened at once - and to reiterate, *not fucking happy, Jan.*

And yet, alongside that frustration, there’s also this very real sense of gratitude and happiness. Turns out you can be happy and sad at the same time. No problem. You get used to juggling emotion by this age. It's all good.

So, for the record, I have to say how grateful I am for my beautiful husband, who, when we first got married, was always busy with his own things — DIY projects, building cars, all those roles that naturally fell his way — and I was more than happy to take care of the cooking. That was just how things settled between us.

Now, because I can’t properly use my arm, he’s in the kitchen with me, following my instructions as I stand slightly uselessly to one side — chop this, chop that — while I attempt to add spices with my left hand. Within two days, he's kinda remembered some tricks and he's now cooking independently. Well I never. Don't worry, I'm still ordering him about from the couch.

The first night we had roast veggies with mushroom gravy. Absolutely delicious. Food is so much better when you don't cook it yourself. The second night we had what I can only describe as *roast* aloo gobi - potatoes and cauliflower with Indian spices, with a side salad and some yoghurt with fresh ground cummin. He wanted cauliflower cheese but I 'directed' him elsewhere. 

![2252.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/riverflows/EqNEhpQFBQj91J7aywSzsEPyMnB4APVjAt5Q39NHSHgB1pZ3BSZSokjmwuNFW9kwRR2.jpg)

He’s been making me hot water bottles, bringing me glasses of water, making the bed, doing all those small, ordinary things that suddenly don’t feel small when you can’t quite manage them yourself.

I do feel sorry for him. He’s only just finished a big stretch of DIY, probably expecting a bit of rest afterwards, and instead he’s ended up helping me with the most basic tasks. The other day he even had to pull my leggings up for me, which was both completely undignified but a proper giggle.

This is the truth of a good marriage. The 'in sickness and in health bit'. 

And the truth is, I don’t really miss surfing as much as I thought. The ocean itself is the important thing, and it's it’s there all the time - I can hear it from my bedroom at night. I can still walk down to it, still go for a swim, still stand on the sand and watch it move in and out as it always has. I still can’t quite believe that we live in this beautiful town and that this is just part of everyday life now.

Not happy Jan, but happy. Sitting by our newly made fire, Jamie's dinner on the plate, in heaven.

Maybe I should break the other arm.

result.body: In some areas of Finland, a full 25% of primary school boys are on ADHD medication, despite the estimate being 5-8% of children globally might have ADHD. That is a pretty massive difference of up to 500%, but I guess it must be something in the water, and not due to over prescription. In another medication trend, 11.5% of women between the ages of 18-29 were prescribed SSRI anti-depressants last year. For men, it was 4.4% last year. But perhaps more troubling is that girls in the 13-17 year gap has more than doubled, from 3.1% to 7.1% in the last decade. What is interesting is that the report said that anti-depressant prescriptions have "levelled-off" at a historical high, probably because of the recognition of ADHD symptoms. Meaning that rather than anti-depressants, they are put on ADHD medication instead. --- ![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/tarazkp/242NoLyTs9ukW5oynnxhJfnkc2Li8ZEHmkGUAiR4jqKKng7RifZTBy1hgtqbbgKbbTmGn.png) --- While I recognise that there are plenty of times that medication is useful and necessary, I have lots of issues with medicating like this based on behavioural symptoms, because behaviour can give a false positive for a behavioural condition. Sounds silly, I know. But if a behaviour is conditioned by the environment to become a habit, then is it a mental problem like ADHD or depression? By my estimation, certain behaviours can *look like* a mental problem, but are not. For instance, attention deficit might be the way a person is, or it could be caused by the way a person has been trained to behave - for example with a constant stream of short-form content, gaming and a lack of activity that requires attention from a young age. A lot of boys these days have been raised on screens that provide an environment that nurtures a lack of attention span - so is that really ADHD? What about for depression? >Key Characteristics and Symptoms: > >- **Emotional Characteristics:** Persistent sadness, tearfulness, or feelings of emptiness. Feelings of worthlessness, guilt, or hopelessness. Increased irritability, restlessness, or frustration. >- **Behavioral and Cognitive Characteristics:** Loss of interest or pleasure in almost all activities (anhedonia). Difficulty concentrating, remembering, or making decisions. Social withdrawal from friends and family. Recurrent thoughts of death or suicide. >- **Physical Characteristics:** Fatigue and lack of energy. Significant weight loss or gain, or increased/decreased appetite. Sleep disturbances, such as insomnia or sleeping too much. Unexplained aches, pains, headaches, or cramps. That is a lot of symptoms and there are many more, but I wonder how many of them could also be triggered by the environment, the way people consume content and what activities they choose to do. Because I would suspect that if a person spends the majority of their time scrolling short-form social feeds alone, looking at content that increases feelings of insecurity (in many forms), doesn't move enough, doesn't socialise enough, and doesn't create enough, they are going to tick a lot of those boxes that are used to describe depression. # If it looks like a duck, walks like a duck and quacks like a duck, then it’s probably a duck. *Untrue.* Back in the past, for sure. If you saw an animal looking, walking and sounding like a duck, it was almost certainly a duck. But that is not the case when it comes to many things these days, including behavioural issues. Using this heuristic means that there are going to be a great deal of false-positives, just like believing every image of a person or video showing a situation these days is the truth, is going to do the same. Behaviours are *trainable* which means that while in some cases there can be a true underlying medical condition that causes it, in other situations it isn't going to be the case at all. It is making an assumption based on the result, without looking at the conditions that lead to that result. For a visualised example, if someone has a tan, the assumption is that they spent time in the sun, whereas it could be that they have used a tanning product or put themselves under a tanning lamp. The preconditions matter, because no matter how much that person "stays out of the sun" if they are tanning in another way, the results aren't going to change. And what I assume now is happening is that overmedication is being used for many result conditions, because it is an easier "solution" than affecting behavioural change. It isn't just for mental conditions either of course, because there are other ones like obesity caused by lack of exercise and poor diet, or stomach issues caused from the wrong eating habits, or cancers caused by *just about everything manufactured.* If we changed our collective behaviours, what would happen to many of these result conditions we are currently medicating? I have heard multiple parents who are *pushing* for ADHD and depression medication for their *primary school age* children, as if that is the solution best fit for their child. And then I see the children, sitting the next to them, scrolling through games and phones and on social media platforms. I personally see it as a form of child abuse, but since it isn't illegal, nothing gets done. And while I am not saying that there is never the place for some medications, I do think that a lot of what is happening now is detrimental to the future of these kids and is far more likely to have many other unintended negative consequences and side-effects that will plague them for their entire lives. We all want to feel good. But if we aren't doing the things that lead us to feel good long-term, we are going to lead ourselves into a state where feeling good becomes impossible without chemical intervention. And even then, it is likely that it will mean we will need more and more intervention if we haven't changed our behaviours that led to the condition in the first place. >A quack is an unqualified person, charlatan, or impostor who pretends to have medical knowledge, skills, or credentials they do not possess. If it looks like a duck...  --- 

 

### Hello my fellow Splinterlands Warriors,

Welcome back to another fresh and juicy Splinterlands post, and I hope all of you are doing pretty well in your lives and enjoying a energetic and peaceful day with your loved ones. For those of you who have made themselves immune to the crypto market and are actively playing this amazing card-based strategy game regularly and working hard to build your NFT card collection, I think most of you are currently busy battling through this new and exciting ranked season. If we take a quick peek at the current ranked season timer, there are still around 9 days and 7 hours left before the season meets its reset point. So there is still enough time in hand to improve your trophy count, secure your goal league tier and win some cool reward chests, and then even make a push for the leaderboard if things go well for you. Just keep in mind to use your battle energy carefully and stay consistent throughout the ranked season.

![Screenshot 2026-04-21 at 11.57.48 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23vrrsZchmKs3LPVdHNNiMDnzPQUtNdsiH7R386izGGypvgTWjD2Qmxry7cnzA5zBxYoR.png)

Now, talking about my own progress in the frontier mode of this game, I am currently playing in the highest Gold I league tier as usual, with a trophy count of around 3,540. My target for this particular season is to reach the 4,200 trophy mark first and then try pushing further for the leaderboard. There is still a fair amount of time left, so I will continue the fight in the bloody arena while hoping for the best.




 --- 

 

![Screenshot 2026-04-21 at 11.25.47 AM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23tbPci4N6CVJhYVYsA9FhachBDntiiE5oBTs84iL3MnugXZ1oyu1ey6udHttT7Qz8EDZ.png)

On the other hand, if we take a look at the weekly Frontier raffle which started just today, I have currently collected a total of 9 entries. With around 6 days and 6 hours left before the raffle draw, I will try to increase this number to somewhere between 54 and 57 entries. Let’s see if luck decides to visit me this time and I finally win something again. Now, in the screenshots above, I have shared the outcome of today's all 3 foundation packs that I won today. As you can see, I have won a legendary, 5 rare cards including 3 archons and all rest common cards. I also was very lucky to win a jackpot card, the Aimee Whisperwind today and the hunt continues for better ones.


 --- 

 
![image-removebg-preview.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AJg2tKKzFdBACvrkXeBbojpnuYSbJ15rTALXTZ8dn7nbHsGMhK2KAFe5jFgGqWC.png)



 --- 

 
### Phlegmost

Now moving forward, let us come to the main topic of this post, as today I will be taking a closer look at another powerful monster from the newest Escalation edition. As you have already seen in the title and thumbnail above, today I will be talking about the Phlegmost. So if you are interested in learning more about this monster card, let us dive deeper without any further delay.

The Phlegmost is a monster type card that was introduced in the game with the newest Escalation edition mini cardset. This monster belongs to the Water element and it comes from the Divine Construct bloodline. By rarity, this card is a Common monster, so you will require a total of 400 CC cards in order to upgrade it to its maximum level. Now, if you want to use this monster in battles, you need to spend 9 mana, which makes it more suitable for medium to high mana limit matches. The attack type of this monster is Magic, and apart from its magical damage, it also comes with a balanced defensive setup of armor and health but at decently low speed. At its maximum level, this monster gains a total of four abilities, which makes it a dangerous and durable card. Let us now take a closer look at its league-wise stats and abilities below to find out more about this monster.


 --- 

 
![Screenshot 2026-04-21 at 12.01.05 PM.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23w28fhFotEK5cWURQXpC9cM3NVfcfRGZL3M88hvkzWPUj26WDWLAnsJK5CixLucFR44U.png)



 --- 

 
#### BRONZE

At level 3, this monster starts with strong stats that consist of 2 magic attack power at 1 speed with 2 armor and 5 health. Apart from these stats, it gains Fury from level 1 and Reprisal from level 3. This gives the monster a dangerous counterplay against heavy attackers and Taunt-based strategies.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23uQiCBFNtVAuHBouXQpw876UjjsrSXqWsSUhprhkjMKA4hC3sTVhANKvNMBpji98Gmgd.png)

`FURY` – Deals double damage if the target has Taunt.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/AK3dd2P98viS1KvX4W1hpytdUVeHSNVhT5Vkk67q5eH5Q1U7JTo5ftXE6w1jiLJ.png)


`REPRISAL` – If an enemy unit deals more than 5 damage in a round, it gains Taunt and if camouflaged, is revealed.



#### SILVER

When you upgrade this monster further to level 5, its stats improve slightly and it now holds 2 magic attack power at 1 speed with 2 armor and 6 health. At this level, it also gains another useful ability called Weaken. This ability weakens the entire enemy team right from the start of battle.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wWnWbgeRXaug6q7cpTf6LPQUYgLt4bCG7Wocou9Tzhgt5pqjjAHnLu51r3KGXZMLRjV.png)


`WEAKEN` – Reduces the maximum health of all enemy units by 1.



#### GOLD

As this monster gets upgraded further and reaches level 8, its stats improve and it now carries 3 magic attack power at 2 speed with 2 armor and 7 health. Even though it does not unlock a new ability at this level, the higher attack power and better speed make it much more effective.

#### DIAMOND / CHAMPION

Finally, when you upgrade this monster to its maximum level of 10, it becomes even harder to remove. It now holds 3 magic attack power at 2 speed with 2 armor and 8 health. At this level, it also gains another powerful ability called Heal. This ability greatly increases its survivability in longer battles.

![image.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/mango-juice/23wMRrQFJaZEJzr8CXcybF59ZWsQE3omp6Bxe1WkwyMEniDgrLvhsaJX1WNDgFrcWsk84.png)

`HEAL` – Each round, heals 1/3 of its maximum health (rounded down).



Last but not least, I think this monster can be extremely useful in many different battles. First of all, it comes with a solid defensive setup and gains Heal at max level, which means it can stay alive for a long time in lengthy matches. Another strong point is its magic attack power, which directly targets enemy health while its armor helps absorb some physical damage early on. Even though the speed starts low, it improves at higher levels. The Fury ability is also very valuable against Taunt monsters. Since it deals double damage, this monster can strike Taunt targets with a massive 6 magic damage at max level. On top of that, the Weaken ability lowers enemy health across the board, while Reprisal can punish enemy monsters that deal 5 or more damage by forcing Taunt onto them. Overall, I think the Phlegmost is a powerful and durable magic monster that becomes even more dangerous in long battles. What do you think?

#### I hope you enjoyed reading my post about PHLEGMOST. Let me know your thoughts about today's post in the comments section below, and I look forward to seeing you all in my next post.

지난 금요일 회사에 있는데 아내에게 온 전화를 못 받았습니다.
전화 온 사실을 30분 쯤 지나서 알게 되었는데 전화를 해보니 그땐 아내가 전화를 안받더라구요.
메시지를 보내도 답이 없고.. 그렇게 엇갈려서 무슨일이 있는지 몰랐는데 한시간 가량 후에 통화가 되서 아내가 하는 얘기는 접촉사고가 있었다는 겁니다.
아내 말로는 아내가 가해차량이고 피해차량은 작은 트럭이었답니다.
서로의 라이드미러가 모두 부서질 정도로 사고가 났었고, 혹시 몰라서 보험회사를 불렀고, 우리쪽이랑 상대방 보험회사에서 모두 왔답니다. 그리고 보험회사에만 알렸을 뿐인데 어느 사이엔가 견인차가 왔고, 수리를 해야 한다면서 단골 카센터가 있는지 있다면 그곳으로 가고 없다면 본인 카센터에 맡기라 했답니다. 아내는 어떻게 해야 몰라서 그때 저에게 전화를 했던 거였구요.

그리고 차량도 무상으로 임대를 해주었다고 하더라구요.

큰 일이 아닌 것 같아서 퇴근하고 나서 확인하기로 했습니다.
퇴근하고 나서 혹시 몰라 아내라 병원에 가 보았고, 아내가 찍어 둔 사고 당시의 사진도 자세히 볼 수 있었습니다.
정말 사이드미러만 나갔더라구요. 상대방 차량도 그렇구요.

그렇게 주말이 지났고, 어제 제가 카센터에 전화를 해보았습니다.
보험료 인상되는 구간 안에서만 수리를 하려고 했었죠. 
그런데 담당자는 사이드미러만이 아니라 앞범퍼, 조수석 앞뒤 문짝, 휀다, 뒷범퍼까지 모두 손상이 되어서 모두 교체를 해야 한답니다.
사기꾼 냄새가 나서 우선 상대방 차량이 입고가 되면 연락을 주기로 했습니다.

오후에 상대방 차량이 입고가 되었고, 카센터가 아니라 상대방 보험회사에서 전화가 왔습니다.
어디까지 수리를 할 거냐구요.
카센터에서 저에게 얘기했던 방식으로 상대차주에게도 얘기했나 보더라구요.
서로 과실이 있다 보니 저희가 카센터에서 말하는 것처럼 전부 수리하면 상대차량도 전부 수리하겠다 하고, 사이드미러만 바꿀거면 본인들도 그렇게 하겠답니다.
당연히 사이드미러만 교체한다 했고, 카센터에 전화해서 그렇게 하기로 했습니다.
그리고 비용이 많이 나오지 않으니 보험이 아니라 서로 각자 일반수리로 하기로 했구요.

당연히(?) 카센터 담당의 목소리가 처음과 다릅니다.
틱틱 거리는 반응.

사이드미러 교체정도니 금방 될 거라 생각했는데 오늘까지 연락이 없네요.
우선 무상으로 차량을 임대해줬으니 아쉬울 것이 없어서 기다리고는 있는데 내일은 전화해서 점심시간에 찾으러 가야겠습니다.
근처라고 했는데 찾아보니 20km 는 되는 거리네요. ㅠ

https://images.ecency.com/DQmQE9U7QjSCqnchjbAZknemCbWTgXgjeASiKTae1mAeHtz/mi_portada.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png
Más que química, física o biología, creo que la gestión de emociones debería ser parte fundamental de nuestra formación académica. Cuando pienso en todo lo que me ha afectado el estrés, no puedo evitar imaginar lo que podría mejorar la calidad de vida de las personas, la gestión apropiada de lo que siente. Un simple llamado de atención de un jefe, puede convertirse en un huracán devastador y, aunque objetivamente no pasa nada, nuestra mente puede experimentarlo con tanta intensidad, que nos agota en extremo. Cada quien hace lo mejor que puede con las herramientas que tiene, pero ¿qué tal si tuviéramos más herramientas? Y no se trata de reprimir lo que sentimos, sino de colocar cada emoción en su lugar. No es igual vivir una pérdida humana, que perder un empleo, sin embargo, en nuestro interior esto puede parecerse mucho... Aún así, creo que ante cada una debemos encontrar la manera de sobreponernos, con el menor daño posible.
More than chemistry, physics, or biology, I believe that managing emotions should be a fundamental part of our academic education. When I think about how stress has affected me, I can’t help but imagine how much people’s quality of life could improve if they learned to manage their feelings properly. A simple reprimand from a boss can turn into a devastating hurricane, and even though objectively nothing is wrong, our minds can experience it with such intensity that it exhausts us to the extreme. Everyone does the best they can with the tools they have, but what if we had more tools? And it’s not about suppressing what we feel, but about putting each emotion in its proper place. Experiencing the loss of a loved one is not the same as losing a job; yet, deep down, it can feel very similar… Even so, I believe that in the face of each situation, we must find a way to move forward with as little harm as possible.
***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmNpnRj28H5oBRG6C5jK75X2bCvk1SqxG3n8Bgf6TQkj4u/20260410_184717.jpg
***
Entonces, la idea no es controlar las emociones, ni tampoco guardarlas bajo la alfombra para que nadie las vea... Lo mejor es agarrar el toro por los cachos y gestionarlas. Y no se trata de un tema de moda, ni de un lujo: es una necesidad básica de supervivencia. Si no somos capaces de identificar y drenar lo que nos afecta, en algún punto colapsaremos y lo peor es que eso no solo nos afecta a nosotros, sino que también alcanza a las personas que amamos (que son las que más nos importan).
So, the idea isn’t to control our emotions, nor to sweep them under the rug so no one sees them… The best approach is to take the bull by the horns and manage them. And this isn’t just a passing trend or a luxury: it’s a basic necessity for survival. If we aren’t able to identify and release what’s affecting us, at some point we’ll break down—and the worst part is that this doesn’t just affect us, but also the people we love (who matter most to us).
***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmaJ74PrMoXxC3GLj4B7mRg95GX53j9twZWwoTtw2qjL38/20260420_165745.jpg
***
No podemos ser un puerto seguro para nadie, si nosotros mismos no nos sostenemos. Es importante aprender a convivir con el miedo sin permitirle paralizarnos, o a sentir enojo sin que llegue a lastimar a otros. Lo que sentimos es inevitable, pero reaccionar de manera irracional, es opcional. Hoy, ya no me interesa tanto ser la fuerte, más bien intento ser alguien capaz de preguntarse: ¿Por qué me siento así?¿Es eso realmente una amenaza para mí?¿Qué puedo hacer para sentirme mejor? Al gestionar nuestras emociones, elegimos la calma ante la tempestad; mostramos madurez y evitamos lastimar a otros, o a nosotros mismos.
We cannot be a safe haven for anyone if we cannot support ourselves. It is important to learn to live with fear without letting it paralyze us, or to feel anger without letting it hurt others. What we feel is inevitable, but reacting irrationally is optional. Today, I’m no longer so interested in being the strong one; rather, I try to be someone capable of asking myself: Why do I feel this way? Is this really a threat to me? What can I do to feel better? By managing our emotions, we choose calm in the face of the storm; we show maturity and avoid hurting others—or ourselves.
***
https://images.ecency.com/DQmQo8kegf7ESGpzsyFzx8myHLFu95wSav3H9GL1awnQXRo/20260413_083544.jpg
https://images.ecency.com/DQmbCVkiZrRxXwagi66h8U8HT3PQgpx2dZx7ZTs8ZKtUYu1/mi_sep.png
Y estas son las reflexiones que quería compartir con ustedes hoy amigos. Cada día nos ofrece un lienzo en blanco, listo para que construyamos nuestros sueños, trazo a trazo. A ustedes, gracias por haberme acompañado a través de estas letras.
And these were my thoughts to share with you today, friends. Every day gives us a blank canvas, ready for us to build our dreams, line by line. To you, thank you for joining me in this reading.
***

result.body: ![IMG_8107-1.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/EpLgUxW3fH6btBHgnFYjYVTwpWJVPcFyLQAR9R5WtponQuhGnMndYQjiHMv8DJEa2Jb.JPG) Today, I’m looking back once again on our last short trip to the Aizu region. The seasons were just changing, and the nature around us hadn’t quite awakened from its winter slumber yet. But even so, the world around us revealed a very special, utterly charming side that quickly captivated me again. Here in the countryside, and especially here in the mountains, we get to experience a completely different Japan than the one we see in travel brochures. Everything is simpler and older, yet somehow more genuine and heartwarming. I feel at home here, and away from the well-known tourist destinations and sights, I find plenty of things to enjoy. It’s often the simplest things, like trains passing over a bridge in front of or behind you. I’m not quite sure what makes such sights so appealing—maybe it’s the feeling that we would love to be sitting on one of those trains yourself, watching the world go by. In this case, it would be wanderlust while you’re already out wandering. It actually sounds pretty funny, but somehow it’s probably true. At least for me, who’s probably quite susceptible to that kind of feeling. And even in our modern times, trains often retain a slightly romantic character, quite unlike airplanes, for example. When flying, we see far too little, and on top of that, it’s usually quite cramped and not really comfortable. Train travel, on the other hand, has a completely different character and brings us very close to the land and its people. It doesn’t matter whether we stop at huge main stations or small stations in the countryside—though I currently prefer the smaller, dreamy stations where only a handful of people get on or off. Well, we didn’t board this time and just carried our longings onto the trains ahead of us. A little melancholy is part of real travel, and dreaming is explicitly allowed. That was probably why I was so excited when I saw the little trains passing over the bridges ahead of us. I’ll admit, our timing wasn’t a coincidence—especially when it came to the big bridge, it was planned in advance. But out here, where trains only run every few hours, a little planning isn’t a bad idea, and it also builds the anticipation that adds just the right spice to the whole experience. And even though the view of the larger bridge and the vast, forested river valley is a bit more impressive and majestic, I was still very happy when the little train rolled past us on the small bridge overpass. As I said, we didn’t just happen to see it by chance, even if it was ultimately a nearly spontaneous decision. In my mind, I’m still waving my arms. And even now as I write these lines, I wish I was sitting on that very train, taking a trip through the heart of the country. With no destination and no rush, just being on the move, for the sake of traveling. The world would pass me by, and my dreams and thoughts would join me on a wonderful journey. I could set off right now! ![IMG_7132.JPG](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/Eoc6yGRyd1vtAvoaPuVzkCVebvFY7QYL5Y6KceC61nejfWK9S57S9Ezc26UXJtmjFHj.JPG) ![blog-ende.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/maxinpower/23tv6H18WKn98nBVkn2MwVhwWsuFRFgjBGwxLEMVhRZD7zRRbFokaNiAn39fUaB3TxVX6.png)

*** ![szablon cover — Odzyskano.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23wCA6d2Rqajcqp28Srz9PhMrbpFjUS9AD79VGAWVwsDTjjA6N8vSKbdXRtc5JCfmpNs7.jpg) ***
### Hello Black And White Community!
When I visit mountains, I often think about the processes that shape them. About the immense forces of nature that cause the massive rock masses that make up our planet's crust to rise. And very often, my mind can't comprehend it, though there are days when I can imagine it. Do you can imagine this?
> Kiedy odwiedzam góry, bardzo często myślę o procesach, które je kształtują. O ogromnych siłach natury, doprowadzających do wypiętrzenia się potężnych mas skalnych budujących skorupę naszej planety. I bardzo często moja głowa nie potrafi tego pojąć, choć są takie dni, kiedy jestem w stanie to sobie wyobrazić. A Wy jesteście?
![bnw.png](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23t6zsny35YcJ1HbmgsdTgAAdRFDg5nkzovenFhgYo3wVbLkhrMtYFFvyKGXCptT7SCYC.png) *** ![PSX_20260420_004923.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23uFPqVwbnuQ3jwZTruN9CMbreBHqMg29aztK4Zv4szgK7YanUbMJc8szmsGomHMz2vsr.jpg) ***
Once, these rocks rested peacefully, hidden deep beneath the surface, unobtrusive, unseen. Now, they attract crowds of tourists, like me, eager to witness their vastness and power. Many of these gawkers are likely unaware of the processes that led to the formation of all tall mountains.
> Niegdyś te skały spoczywały spokojnie, ukryte głęboko pod powierzchnią, nikomu nie zawadzały, nie szukały uwagi. Teraz przyciągają masę turystów, takich jak ja, chcących zobaczyć ich ogrom i potęgę. Wielu z tych gapiów jest zapewne nieświadomych procesów, które doprowadziły do powstania wszelkich wysokich gór.
*** ![PSX_20260420_005025.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23tH5j8Ypz5i2rJXDJos8EEszkTTB2JbBdKTRzWdUEeYNWYUVzK8KeyYfuX2QtddHTsAK.jpg) ***
It is estimated that the entire formation of the Tatra Mountains took several dozen million years, with the final stage of their uplift occurring 10–15 million years ago. The Alps and Himalayas also formed during a similar period. Although mountain formation ceased long ago, these mountains, like all others, are still being formed in some way.
> Szacuje się, że całkowity proces formowania Tatr trwał kilkadziesiąt milionów lat, a ostateczny moment ich wypiętrzania miał miejsce 10–15 milionów lat temu. W podobnym okresie formowały się również Alpy i Himalaje. Mimo że ruchy górotwórcze ustały dawno temu, to góry te, jak każde inne, wciąż w jakiś sposób są formowane.
*** ![PSX_20260420_005010.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23vhz1dzJAGYaLu95hUaT6gF5iRTxhhVCQrQPWoBnNSm7ag9aMXCKbCs56U1yLTVaqM3K.jpg) ***
Wind and rainfall, and especially glaciers, are responsible for the continuous but very long-term transformation of mountains. Glaciers are responsible for the formation of many, if not most, mountain lakes. They are responsible, among others, for the formation of the lakes in the **Valley of Five *Spiš* Lakes**.
> Wiatr i opady deszczu, a w szczególności lodowce, odpowiadają za ciągłe, ale bardzo długotrwałe przekształcanie się gór. Lodowce odpowiadają za powstanie wielu, o ile nie większości, górskich jezior. Odpowiadają między innymi za powstanie jezior w **Dolinie Pięciu Stawów Spiskich**.
*** ![PSX_20260420_004958.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23x196MCM8mNFdnTrN6542c5jF3Tp15VGHZNHBAYScNPvTx6TV5mxycTnzcvKoKRG3Qwj.jpg) ***
In this never-ending transformation of the mountain landscape, photography plays a significant role. Perhaps over the course of a lifetime, the changes in the mountain landscape won't be significant enough for us to see clearly, and certainly not overnight. But someone in the distant future who sees photographs of the Tatra Mountains taken in our own time might say, "Wait, those mountains look completely different now."
> W tej niekończącej się transformacji górskiego krajobrazu fotografia odgrywa sporą rolę. Być może na przestrzeni całego ludzkiego życia zmiany w górskim krajobrazie nie będą na tyle znaczące, abyśmy mogli je wyraźnie zobaczyć, a już na pewno nie z dnia na dzień. Ale ktoś, kto w odległej przyszłości zobaczy zdjęcia Tatr wykonane w naszych czasach, być może powie: „Chwila, przecież te góry wyglądają teraz zupełnie inaczej”.
*** ![PSX_20260420_004946.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/241tX7v9pN92CJChicf3KJQLo1Hcj5PYwdx8z8XiaC2MUVVYkfnDgwrFrMAJLoW4pkfzh.jpg) ***
I also think this applies to all other landscapes. The world is constantly changing, and what we consider everyday travel photography can prove to be of immense historical and documentary value for future generations.
> Myślę też, że tyczy się to wszelkich innych krajobrazów. Świat ciągle się zmienia i coś, co dla nas jest codzienną fotografią podróżniczą, dla przyszłych pokoleń może okazać się mieć ogromną wartość historyczną i dokumentalną.
*** ![PSX_20260420_004935.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23yTctro89SqyprfvZQyFF6pEdX9dhDmSnM4jGEDugFFPwPUE2NyL3R4FtGraZhHNXCp3.jpg) ***
I'd love to have access to photos of the formation of such mountains myself. I'm incredibly curious about what a time-lapse video of mountains forming would look like - photos taken every year, in the same place, at the same time. However, that's a rather abstract dream.
> Sam chciałbym mieć dostęp do zdjęć z formowania się takich gór. Niezmiernie pochłania mnie ciekawość, jak wyglądałby film poklatkowy przedstawiający formujące się góry — zdjęcia wykonane co roku, w tym samym miejscu, o tej samej porze. To jednak dość abstrakcyjne marzenie.
*** ![PSX_20260420_005036.jpg](https://files.peakd.com/file/peakd-hive/inmyframe/23wWvxPry4J2DNfm2umgcpxsytCUTSAT1NTymg5fKWCJFYJakFTM5RZm5L6YtCDPfsjHy.jpg) ***

Hello everyone. How are you today? I hope all is well with you and your family. In Chai Prakan District, Chiang Mai Province, there are many ethnic groups. One of them is Yunnan Chinese. This ethnic group relocated to Chiang Mai several decades ago. This district has many villages of Yunnan Chinese. Some of these Yunnan Chinese villages are located on the plains, some on the plateaus and some on the mountains. A few months ago, my wife and I visited Doi Ang Khang. Although Doi Ang Khang is located in the mountains of our district, but this trip took us on main roads, rural roads, roads winds over the plateau and mountain roads in Chai Prakan district too. We passed through many villages. Including local Thai villages, Tai Yai people villages, and Yunnan Chinese villages. Especially the Yunnan Chinese villages on the mountains. These villages have a nice atmosphere and scenery. Although on this trip, we didn't visit these Yunnan Chinese villages on the mountains. But I photographed the atmosphere and scenery of a Yunnan Chinese village. And I want to share this with everyone in this post too.
